text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Pant!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (As I thought, they really are amazing!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I was so overwhelmed by the pressure
emanating
from Oguri and the others
that I couldn't perform
as well as I'd
hoped to!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Are you entering the autumn Tenno
Sho?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I intend to, yes. And that's not all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall defeat you there.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Glad to hear it. Bring it on, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold up!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's the big idea, keeping me out of
the loop?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Inari...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
For the record, I'm also runnin' the
autumn Tenno
Sho. Creek, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(That means the Eternal Top Three will
all be
there!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I like that fire in your eyes! You
know,
you're actually pretty easy to
read.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Better buckle up though. You're in for
the ride of
a lifetime. I'll be seeing you,
Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It appears as though luck is on our side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The Eternal Top Three will all be
present. I
couldn't have wished for a
finer opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's devote all the energy we
possess to the
autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And then... claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
History, and this very moment... Who will
they
smile upon? The hour in which we'll
find out is
rapidly approaching...
